scope: Local test database cleanup and database-backup list views

implementation.history_view: all executions retained; switching views does not delete records
implementation.available_condition: Successful job with non-empty URI on its latest non-deleted artifact; filtered before count/pagination
implementation.file_integrity: File registration is shown separately; actual existence/checksum verification occurs on restore
implementation.compatibility: Omitting view preserves old list behavior

validation.repository_regression: Pagination and totals, policy/status filters, soft-deleted and empty registrations, duplicate artifacts, latest-record semantics

limits: Existing user Core/Web processes were not restarted; updated server filter requires local backend restart
Browser API was a controlled fixture; actual PostgreSQL repository filtering was checked separately
